items.html: And this is the matter of eating and drinking, as is explained by us: the Mochin of the female are called YH YH, and they are made from the aspect of YH, and they are drawn into her through eating and drinking. And this is the meaning of "eating" (achila): AChL YH. "Drinking" (shetiya): ShT YH — for through food and drink, Mochin called YH are drawn into her. Also, she herself is hinted in the word "achila," whose gematria is ADNY (Adonai), 65, to hint that these Mochin of YH drawn through eating are in the female called Adonai.
